# Shootly (working name)

> Booking marketplace for photographers and videographers in India. Pilot city: Hyderabad. Customers see the creator, the all-in price, what is delivered and by when before paying.

## Key facts
- A booking is confirmed only after the creator accepts and payment is verified.
- Creators are ID-verified and manually reviewed before listing.
- Packages state hours, deliverables, delivery deadline and cancellation terms.
- If a creator cancels a confirmed booking, the customer gets replacement options or a full refund.
- Shoot types: birthdays, family, graduations, reels, product, restaurant content.

## Pages
- [Home](https://www.example.com/): what the service is, how booking works, FAQ
